values: 一名低调随和的战士，可以支援能量较高的队友，收起武器后会变的更强。
A serene Warrior who empowers allies when their Energy is high. He always says his true strength isn't in his weapon, but in his mind.
Calm your mind, to still your heart.
Hmm. Slow down and feel the change.
You need to turn around and strike. It's that simple.
A treasure given, a treasure kept. My thanks.
Let's get on with the challenge.
异乡的食物也别有风味啊
早年潘仍在故土修行时，遇到过一位来自异国的年轻剑客，那位剑客手中的剑有着风与冰的力量。正是与这位异国朋友的相识激起了潘前往远方看看的念头。

Before Pang left his homeland, when he was still training, he met a young swordsman from a distant land. The stranger's blades were infused with the power of wind and ice. That encounter was what first made Pang dream of journeying beyond his borders.
潘手中的武器是一根普通的竹子，对武者来说，修行到极致，摘叶飞花皆可为兵器——总之，大部分时间下，那竹子不是储备粮。

Pang's weapon? Just a plain piece of bamboo. For a true martial artist, even a leaf or flower can be deadly when mastered. That said... most of the time, the bamboo is just for show, and of course, he doesn't plan on eating it.
潘的掌法远胜棍法，为了控制自己出手的强度，他才经常手持竹棍。
Pang's palm strikes are far deadlier than his staff techniques. To hold back his full power, he usually fights with his bamboo staff.
潘擅长在山林中静静冥想，感受自然的气息，虽然对外人来说很难分清他到底是睡着了还是在修行。
Pang often meditates quietly in the remote mountains and forests of Esperia, breathing in the essence of nature. To outsiders, it's hard to tell whether he's deep in thought or just asleep.
潘身形强健，但行动却比外形看起来更加轻捷迅速。
Some people would say that Pang is powerfully built, but don't let that fool you. He moves with surprising speed... like a boulder enchanted with a haste spell.
连潘自己也不能否认，在很饿的时候，曾经偷偷啃过手中的竹棍。
When pressed for an answer, even Pang can't deny that, one time, when hunger struck, he nibbled on his bamboo staff a bit. But he swears it was only once.
无论走到哪里，潘始终记得来自师傅的教诲：从不以武欺人，但也从不畏惧面临挑战。
Wherever he goes, Pang never forgets his master's teachings. He never uses his skills to bully others, but never backs down from a fight.
遇到不公之事，潘从不吝于出手相助。
When injustice strikes, Pang never hesitates to step in and help.
潘小时候最大的愿望就是成为一名行侠仗义的武者，第二大的愿望就是拥有一片永远啃不完的竹林。
When Pang was little, his biggest dream was to become a heroic warrior. His second-biggest? An endless bamboo forest he could munch on forever.
“是一位很有魅力又超可爱的成熟的黑白相间的侠客救了我。”某位差点被抢劫的女性受害者给出的证词一度让骑士团有些头痛，直到他们遇到了潘。

"A cute black-and-white warrior saved me. Don't tell him this, but I wanted to hug him so bad."—Testimony from a robbery victim given to the Heroic Order (They were confused until they saw Pang themselves.)
This stick is getting a bit old.
